svg.title: Reading g from the graph of f
svg.desc: Top: the graph of f on [0, 8]: a line from (0, 2) down to (2, 0), a semicircle of radius 2 below the x-axis from x = 2 to x = 6, and a line from (6, 0) up to (8, 2). The triangles above the axis have area 2 each; the half-disc below has area 2 pi. Bottom: the graph of g(x), the integral of f from 0 to x. It rises to a relative maximum of 2 at x = 2, falls to a relative minimum of 2 - 2 pi, about -4.28, at x = 6, and rises to 4 - 2 pi at x = 8. Its inflection point is at x = 4, where f changes from decreasing to increasing.

text.tspan: relative max at x = 2: f changes + to −
relative min at x = 6: f changes − to +
f turns from decreasing to increasing
: area above the axis adds, area below subtracts
